label: PF Backlog 460
title: FLAKY: worker-agent e2e fails under heavy load (readiness/register deadline) - RCCA
body:
Source: precheck --full (2026-10-07) during BI-PF-0420.

FINDING: `test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_workergrid_agent_e2e.py::test_agent_no_work_exits_clean` FAILED in
the full suite (which took 3642s vs the usual ~150s, with many "[GeminiClient] Error: 429 ... quota" lines),
but PASSES in isolation (1.37s) and in the immediate --full re-run (379.6s, PASS). So it is flaky, not a real
regression.

RCCA (5-Why):
1. The full gate failed -> the agent e2e test failed.
2. The agent e2e test failed only in the degraded full run.
3. The suite was ~24x slower because LLM-dependent tests retried on provider 429 (quota) - machine saturated.
4. Under that load the e2e harness's readiness/register deadlines (coordinator ready 15s; agent register 60s)
   are tight enough to trip.
5. Guard: make the e2e harness robust under load (raise the coordinator-readiness + register deadlines, and/or
   make the LLM-dependent tests skip when the provider quota is exhausted) so a degraded environment cannot
   flake the gate.

Fix (proposed, not a shortcut): increase the harness deadlines + add a quota-aware skip; keep the test's real
assertions. Small change to the e2e harness.
